title: Candidate
description: Something that could fill a need, found in a source catalog: its licence, releases and activity as the registry gives them, and its fit and outcome as a choice records them. A model is a candidate too, catalogued by task: the tasks it does, its name at the gateway, the leaderboard scores it was picked on (as the board stated them), and what substrate measured of it.

registry.description: the source catalog it came from (a component in system sources): github, deps-dev, ...

licence.description: SPDX identifier as the registry reports it

latest_release.description: the newest release that is not a pre-release

last_push.description: the last push to its repository (YYYY-MM-DD)

fit.description: what it does, against the need

trial.description: what it did in the trial

reason.description: why it was picked or rejected

tasks.description: for a model: what it does, as Hugging Face's task tags name it (text-generation, feature-extraction, ...)

model.description: for a model: its name at the gateway (provider/name)

scores.description: for a model: leaderboard scores it was picked on, by board, as the board or model card stated them

measured.description: for a model: what substrate measured, by stream and handler (calls, answers, scored, correct, mean cost) or by trial
